FEAT-5-S167.title: Tool Allowlist Schema and Registration Contract
FEAT-5-S167.description: Define and enforce a centralized allowlist schema that maps tool names to their handler functions and corresponding Pydantic models, ensuring only explicitly registered tools can be invoked by the router.

FEAT-5-S168.title: Safe Tool Execution Wrapper with Error Isolation
FEAT-5-S168.description: Implement a safe execution wrapper around tool handlers that isolates runtime errors, prevents crashes in the agent loop, and returns structured error responses without leaking internal exceptions.

FEAT-5-S169.title: Chat History Injection into Tool Context
FEAT-5-S169.description: Implement logic to inject relevant chat history and context into tool execution inputs where required, ensuring tools receive sufficient context while maintaining validation boundaries.

FEAT-5-S170.title: Tool Router Integration with FastAPI Entry Point
FEAT-5-S170.description: Ensure the tool router is fully integrated into the FastAPI application loop, enabling end-to-end handling of tool_use events from incoming chat requests through execution and response return.
